page.overview:
Who is Blake?

Blake is a former FBI hostage negotiator who now works for ChoreMonkey.

Marge was angry at Homer because of all the ChoreMonkeys in their house, so Homer calls him. Blake uses his former negotiator skills to calm Marge down, and convince her about ChoreMonkey's advantages by fixing her ice maker.

Later, he tries to use his skills to convince Maggie to stop sucking on her pacifier. However, this time, he fails as he starts sucking on a pacifier.
